propositions: A committed operational script must build and prove the history strip on a scratch unfiltered clone using stock Git plumbing before any publication or remote modification.
The rewrite must strip both .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from all historical revisions while preserving commit count, merge count, and DAG topology.
After dynamic re-add of current .bridge_state files, the rewritten branch tree must be byte-identical to the original tip tree, and the rewritten pack must measure under 150 MB.
The script must refuse execution on partial (blob:none) clones, assert absence of the protected remote tag from the rewritten clone, and leave both the source remote branch and tag unchanged.
All graph, tree, history-removal, and pack-size assertions must complete before the script emits success, and no remote push operation is permitted in the dry run.
